## Professional summary

Full Stack Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience building real-time systems, AI-integrated backends, and async workflows across healthtech, hiring-tech, and edtech. Promoted to Project Manager while retaining full ownership of backend architecture — now leads a 15–20 member team.

## Experience

### Project Manager — Mithila Stack (July 2026 – Present)
- Company-level Project Manager alongside engineering work.
- Manages multiple projects and a team of 15–20 people.
- Plans work, reduces blockers, and stays close to code for realistic timelines.

### Full Stack Engineer — Mithila Stack (March 2024 – Present)
- Owned backend development across multiple production platforms — an AI interview system, an exam platform, and a healthcare adherence tool — from architecture through deployment.
- Designed queue-based async workflows using BullMQ and Redis for time-sensitive tasks like patient reminders and exam evaluation.
- Integrated third-party AI services (Gemini, Azure AI, D-ID) and payment flows (Razorpay), with role-based access and secure data handling.
- Deployed and maintained 25+ full-stack applications and 10+ landing pages using Docker across AWS and VPS hosts, with Jenkins CI/CD for zero-downtime automated releases.

## Production systems

1. **Meleys — AI-powered Interview & Evaluation Platform** (Live: https://meleys.ai)
   - Real-time interview platform handling 100–150 concurrent sessions with ~40–50ms event capture latency.
   - Supports 2,500+ interviews across 1,000+ candidates.
   - ~85% scoring accuracy aligning AI-evaluated responses against role-specific criteria.
   - Stack: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, WebRTC, Gemini AI.

2. **MARS — Medication Adherence & Reminder Platform** (Live: https://mars.ai-clinic.tech)
   - Automated WhatsApp medication reminders with AI avatar video for 2,000+ patients.
   - Sends 25,000+ reminders monthly at 90% delivery success.
   - AI voice-agent system for automated patient calls and follow-ups; ~50% improvement in on-time medication adherence.
   - Stack: Node.js, MongoDB, Azure AI, D-ID, FFmpeg, Docker, BullMQ, Redis.

3. **AI Clinic** (Live: https://ai-clinic.tech)
   - Multi-agent patient engagement platform on LiveKit for post-surgery / discharge care.
   - Agents cover pre-surgery prep, medication adherence, post-surgery monitoring, fulfillment, and appointments.
   - WhatsApp reminders with AI doctor avatar videos; integrated with MARS for hospital workflows.
   - Stack: Node.js, Python, LiveKit, MongoDB, Azure AI, D-ID, WhatsApp API, Docker, Jenkins, AWS, BullMQ.

4. **iPariksha — Examination System with Automated Evaluation** (Live: https://ipariksha.com)
   - Backend for large-scale online exams: 1,500+ exams and 5,000+ candidates.
   - Results generated within 5–15 minutes of submission.
   - Razorpay payment and payout flows with strict role-based access control.
   - Stack: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Razorpay.
